messages.content: Now verify: reopen every letter, assert no placeholders remain, values match the CSV, formatting (bold amount, styles) is kept.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": ["bash", "-lc", "cd <scratch>/r17/mp_O7/work/docx_mailmerge/mp-work/3 && python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, glob, os, docx
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('customers.csv', encoding='utf-8')))
files = sorted(glob.glob('letters/*.docx'))
assert len(files) == len(rows) == 5, files
for f, row in zip(files, rows):
    d = docx.Document(f)
    text = '\n'.join(p.text for p in d.paragraphs)
    assert '{{' not in text and '}}' not in text, (f, text)
    assert d.paragraphs[0].style.name == 'Heading 1' and d.paragraphs[0].text == 'Payment reminder'
    assert f"Dear {row['name']}," == d.paragraphs[1].text
    assert d.paragraphs[1].style.name == 'Normal'
    assert row['company'] in d.paragraphs[2].text
    amt = f"{float(row['amount']):,.2f}"
    y,m,dd = row['due_date'].split('-')
    p3 = d.paragraphs[3]
    assert p3.text == f"The outstanding balance is {amt} and it is due on {dd} {m} {y}.", p3.text
    runs = {r.text: r for r in p3.runs}
    assert runs[amt].bold is True, 'amount must stay bold'
    assert d.paragraphs[4].text.startswith('If you have already paid')
    assert d.paragraphs[5].text == 'Kind regards,'
    assert d.paragraphs[6].text == 'Accounts team, Brightline Studio'
    assert len(d.sections) == 1 and d.sections[0].left_margin == 1143000
    print(os.path.basename(f), '|', d.paragraphs[1].text, '|', p3.text)
print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
PY"]}
